import csv
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

site = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example')
fixtures = site / 'fixtures'
packet = Path('products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue')
draft_hash = hashlib.sha256((packet / 'operator-draft.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert draft_hash == '4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b', 'Draft changed. Recheck scope before attaching this sample.'
baseline = fixtures / 'after-shopify.csv'
with baseline.open(encoding='utf-8', newline='') as source:
    reader = csv.reader(source)
    header = next(reader)
    original = list(reader)

def column(name):
    matches = [i for i, label in enumerate(header) if label.strip().casefold().split()[-1:] == [name]]
    assert len(matches) == 1, (name, header)
    return matches[0]

sku_column = column('sku')
barcode_column = column('barcode')
row_number, row = next((i, row) for i, row in enumerate(original) if row[sku_column] and row[barcode_column].isascii() and row[barcode_column].isdigit())
old = row[barcode_column]
new = old[:-1] + str((int(old[-1]) + 1) % 10)
changed = [row.copy() for row in original]
changed[row_number][barcode_column] = new
assert [(i, j) for i, (left, right) in enumerate(zip(original, changed)) for j, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(left, right)) if a != b] == [(row_number, barcode_column)]
command = [sys.executable, str(site / 'verify_example.py'), str(fixtures / 'before-variants.csv'), str(fixtures / 'before-images.csv')]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    negative = Path(tmp) / 'changed.csv'
    with negative.open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as dest:
        writer = csv.writer(dest, lineterminator='\n')
        writer.writerow(header)
        writer.writerows(changed)
    passing = subprocess.run(command + [str(baseline)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    failing = subprocess.run(command + [str(negative)], capture_output=True, text=True)

check = 'identifiers_preserved_sku_barcode_color_size_price'
assert (passing.returncode, failing.returncode) == (0, 1), (passing.stderr, failing.stderr)
assert json.loads(passing.stdout)['failed'] == []
assert json.loads(failing.stdout)['failed'] == [check]
line = row_number + 2
sku = row[sku_column]
report = f'''# Catalogue QA sample / Exemple de contrôle de catalogue

## English

Autonomous AI agents ran the catalogue verifier on fictional CSV files. The baseline passed (exit 0). Changing one barcode yielded exit 1 and flagged the grouped identifier check `{check}`.

Manual comparison located the change in data row {row_number + 1} (CSV line {line}, counting the header), SKU `{sku}`, in the `{header[barcode_column]}` column. The reference value was `{old}` and the test value was `{new}`. The verifier reports the grouped finding. Field and row identification requires comparison of the CSV values.

Scope covers offline CSV comparison. Store access and Shopify import were outside this test.

## Français

Des agents IA autonomes ont exécuté le vérificateur de catalogue sur des fichiers CSV fictifs. Le fichier de référence a réussi le contrôle (code de sortie 0). La modification d’un seul code-barres a produit le code de sortie 1 et signalé le contrôle groupé `{check}`.

La comparaison manuelle a localisé l’écart à la ligne de données {row_number + 1} (ligne CSV {line}, en comptant l’en-tête), pour le SKU `{sku}`, dans la colonne `{header[barcode_column]}`. La valeur de référence était `{old}` et la valeur testée était `{new}`. Le vérificateur signale le contrôle groupé. La localisation du champ et de la ligne exige une comparaison des valeurs CSV.

Le test porte sur la comparaison de fichiers CSV hors ligne. L’accès à la boutique et l’importation Shopify étaient hors périmètre.

## Operator reference / Référence opérateur

Prior control receipt / Exécution précédente `TASK-179567856110`.
Draft SHA-256 / SHA-256 du brouillon `{draft_hash}`.
'''
output = packet / 'operator-sample-report-en-fr.md'
output.write_text(report, encoding='utf-8')
assert output.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == report
print(json.dumps({'baseline_exit': passing.returncode, 'negative_exit': failing.returncode, 'failed_checks': [check], 'csv_line': line, 'draft_sha256': draft_hash, 'report_sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
